card: A/B lockstep separation: same step for A and B with a fixed relative offset (e.g. 8000h) using team-shared memory to coordinate the band; measure partner collisions and score.

model.what: A005 phase-sim.mjs extended with modes (no opponents/zombies, 25 band combos, 200k rounds). Partner kills / early anchor triggers.
model.results: mode0 rev0: A killed by B 9/25, early triggers A 235 B 215. mode1 L0 (A=B step 2C00h/2400h, own bands): 0 kills, A early triggers 377, B 0; robust to A startup delays 7/50/150. mode2 L1 (same step + A band = B band + 8000h): 0 kills, 0 early triggers. mode4 L4 (A 4400h/3C00h, 800h trail, not lockstep): 0 kills at delay 0 but 25/25 B kills at A delay 50 (phase-dependent).

candidates.label: L0
candidates.change: A only: phoenix mov dx,4000h -> 2400h and mov bp,4400h -> 2C00h (A uses B's step 2C00h and 800h trail; own band, no coordination). Same-step lockstep without shared memory. B = base.
candidates.notes: Gains concentrated on the V6 family (threat job: V6/V4/V6Guard all 4/0 with CI above 0; threat team scores fall from 0.43-0.48 to 0.31-0.34). Regression risk on the plain 2025 field (-0.020, not significant). Screen ALL is only just over the bar; A-step edits are chaotic (A007), so treat as a candidate for confirmation only.

candidates.label: L1
candidates.change: L0 plus explicit coordination: B stosw at entry stores its load address in team-shared ES:[0] (DI then 2 for B's INT 87h); A pushes ES at entry, after its INT 87h pops it into DS, reads [0], restores DS, and quantizes B's load with phase 90h (= B phase 10h + 80h), so A's band = B's band + 8000h. +4 A startup turns, +1 B startup turn.
candidates.notes: Versus L0 on the same seeds: ALL -0.020, strong -0.166 (6/7 strong cohorts worse), bomb_IND_BRA -0.167, 2025 +0.013. The fixed 8000h offset moves A's first anchor away from its own (safe) load region and costs startup turns; no benefit over same-step alone.

candidates.label: L4
candidates.change: A only: mov dx,4000h -> 3C00h (800h trail, own step 4400h kept; not lockstep). Non-lockstep control for L0.
candidates.notes: Opposite trade to L0 (2025 +, strong -; lead_V6 -0.128). Owned by A015 (same binary); not claimed here.

threatFindings.threat: Partner crossfire (B's 800h trail killing A mid-rebuild) is removed by giving A and B the same step
threatFindings.evidence: Model lock-sim.mjs only: rev0 9/25 A kills, same-step L0 0/25 for all tested startup delays, L1 0/25 and 0 early triggers. Not measured in battles (effect size ~1-2% of deaths per A005, below screen resolution).

threatFindings.threat: Explicit team-shared-memory offset (A band = B band + 8000h) improves on same-step alone
threatFindings.evidence: L1 jasvo vs L0 yinzl on identical seeds: ALL -0.020, strong -0.166 (6/7 cohorts worse).
threatFindings.impact: Do not coordinate the band via shared memory; placing A far from its own load region costs on the strong field.

threatFindings.threat: A on B's step with an 800h trail beats V6-family leads (same 52h lattice A streams swept mid-trail)
threatFindings.evidence: threat mf5ee (independent seeds, 1 copy + 2 2025 fillers): lead_V6 +0.102 [0.039,0.165], lead_V4 +0.138 [0.081,0.194], lead_V6Guard +0.169 [0.137,0.201], all 4/0; screen yinzl multi +0.054, lead_V4 +0.178, lead_V6Guard +0.103.

threatFindings.threat: The leader gain comes from the 800h trail alone, independent of the shared step
threatFindings.evidence: L4 (800h trail, step 4400h) screen lqqx9/q84cd: lead_V6 -0.128, strong -0.068; single screen, confounded by step chaos.
threatFindings.impact: Suggests the shared 2C00h step matters; unresolved.

threatFindings.threat: L0 regresses on the plain 2025 field
threatFindings.evidence: screen yinzl 2025 -0.0196 [-0.050,0.011] W/L 10/13; A008 saw a similar 2025-vs-strong trade for B step edits.
threatFindings.impact: Up to ~-0.02 on 2025; needs fresh-field confirmation

recommendation: Send L0 (A only: DX 2400h, BP 2C00h; sha cc1f23a2) to confirmation as a promising candidate. Its screen ALL (+0.0070) is just over the bar, but a follow-up threat job on independent seeds shows a large, consistent gain against the V6 family (+0.079 overall vs leaders). Watch the 2025 partitions (screen -0.020). Reject L1: shared-memory 8000h coordination costs about 0.02 compared with L0. Same-step lockstep removes partner kills only in the model.
